_about: Make-row category 'Plazas' (Core/Tool/Shelf.cs; one file per category). New 2026-10-28 (the user: "plazas is going to be its whole new category, because we're going to really outdo ourselves with that"; photos of a lifestyle centre's promenade and a dining plaza by a department store). The squares group (plaza, market square) and the shopping types built round a square or a pedestrian street (mall park, outdoor mall, high street, shopping plaza) are shown here; hide, never delete. See docs/refactor/STRIP-MALLS-PLAZAS.md. Designed plazas (2026-10-28, the user: "very intricate designed plazas ... think of Union Square"): the plaza shows six designed squares (grand square, garden rooms, railed gardens, terraced garden, modern plaza, old-town piazza; Core/Layers/Plaza/PlazaDesigns.cs); the classic compositions round the entrances (civic, fountain, cafe, sunken court, green) are hidden: big, mostly empty slabs next to them (docs/refactor/squares.md, 'Designed plazas').
